name: Pizza
description: Warm, cheesy, and universally loved. Perfect for sharing with friends or a cozy night in.

name: Pasta
description: Hearty and satisfying in every form — from buttery fettuccine to bold bolognese.

name: BBQ
description: Slow-cooked, smoky, fall-off-the-bone goodness that warms the soul.

name: Mac & Cheese
description: The ultimate comfort food — creamy, gooey, and instantly nostalgic.

name: Soul Food
description: Rich, soulful, and deeply comforting. Perfect when you want something warm and familiar.

name: Thai Food
description: Bold and fragrant with a perfect balance of sweet, sour, salty, and spicy.

name: Korean BBQ
description: Grill your own marinated meats at the table — interactive, social, and delicious.

name: Mexican Food
description: Vibrant flavors from tacos to tamales — bold, festive, and deeply satisfying.

name: Indian Curry
description: Complex, aromatic spices create warming curries and vibrant dishes full of depth.

name: Sichuan Chinese
description: Mouth-numbing Sichuan peppercorns and fiery chilies create an addictive flavor bomb.

name: Boba & Bubble Tea
description: Chewy tapioca pearls in sweet, milky tea — the ultimate trendy sweet treat.

name: Bakery & Pastries
description: Flaky croissants, airy macarons, and fresh-baked cakes — pure happiness in every bite.

name: Brunch
description: The best of breakfast and lunch — pancakes, waffles, French toast, and cozy cafe favorites.

name: Dessert Cafes
description: Specialty desserts like matcha tiramisu, souffle pancakes, and artisan ice cream.

name: Acai Bowls
description: Thick, frosty acai blended with banana and topped with fresh fruit and granola.

name: Japanese Food
description: Refined and precise — from silky sushi to warming ramen and delicate tempura.

name: Mediterranean
description: Olive oil, fresh herbs, and vibrant vegetables create clean, satisfying flavors.

name: Poke Bowls
description: Fresh ahi tuna or salmon over rice with colorful toppings and savory sauce.

name: Seafood
description: Crispy fish tacos, butter-poached lobster, or simple steamed clams — the ocean on your plate.

name: Salad & Grain Bowls
description: Build-your-own bowls packed with greens, grains, and satisfying toppings.

name: Burgers
description: A perfectly stacked burger with juicy patty, melted cheese, and all the fixings.

name: Sandwiches & Wraps
description: Stacked high and wrapped tight — endlessly customizable and always satisfying.

name: Food Trucks
description: Street food creativity at its best — from birria tacos to lobster rolls on the go.

name: Ramen
description: Steaming bowls of rich broth with noodles, tender chashu pork, and a soft egg.

name: Dumplings & Dim Sum
description: Bite-sized bundles of joy — soup dumplings, har gow, and siu mai are calling.
